messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for inference-api -> v2.15.0 at 5% (rollout_id=rl-20260323-7). Observability alert: eu-west-1 p95 increased 210ms -> 480ms, 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 0.8% :eyes:
maria: saw the alert. anyone else seeing KV_EVICT spikes?
devin: yep, dashboards show KV_EVICT counter jumping ~30s before p95 spike. only in eu-west.
sanjay: digging into node logs now, tail: `2026-03-23T15:22:10Z KV_EVICT key=usr_ctx size=5120`, repeated. memory on rtx-eu-3 at 78% but not OOM.
erica: release notes for v2.15.0 included a change to kv-cache defaults (maxEntries: 10000 -> 5000). could explain higher churn under same load.
maria: ok — we should pause canary and pin traffic back to v2.14.1 until we confirm config. @deploy-bot can you hold the rollout?
deploy-bot: Action queued: hold rollout rl-20260323-7. Current canary traffic frozen. To pin stable: `rd-deploy pin-service inference-api --version v2.14.1 --confirm`
devin: thanks. I'll collect a short diff of runtime flags and check if any regression tests ran mismatching cache config.
sanjay: captured pod env and config: `CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=5000` on canary pods; stable still `10000`. uploading logs to https://redwood.storage/rl-20260323-7/logs (privileged link).
erica: quick sanity: is this affecting embeddings endpoints or only chat/generation routes?
devin: primarily generation paths — embeddings throughput looks normal. something about longer context and KV churn.
tim: we should also update release notes/ship checklist to call out cache param changes explicitly. almost tripped us.
maria: agreed. immediate plan: 1) pin to v2.14.1 (done), 2) run a config-only canary with `CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=10000` on 1 node, 3) run short load test in eu-west.
deploy-bot: Confirmed: rollout held and traffic reverted to v2.14.1 for inference-api. Rollback plan: `rd-deploy revert rl-20260323-7 --force` (ops approvers: @maria @devin). Ticket created: INC-20260323-11 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260323-11
sanjay: I'll spin a single node with v2.15.0 + CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=10000 and run 5m synthetic generator, will report within 10m.
erica: adding note to release notes PR to highlight the cache default change and mitigation steps.
tim: +1 to pause — also suggest adding a sentinel metric for KV_EVICT > 100/min to auto-hold future canaries.
maria: action items assigned on INC-20260323-11: add sentinel, update ship checklist, and postmortem if root cause confirmed. thanks all. :thumbsup:
devin: will follow up with perf graphs and a short summary once synthetic run completes.
sanjay: synthetic run: p95 back to ~220ms with cache=10000 on the single-node test. attaching snippet: `p95: 218ms`, `5xx: 0.05%`.
maria: good signal. we'll coordinate a controlled reattempt after checklist items. leaving the thread open for any late findings.
